title: Urine specific gravity

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

sources.title: MedlinePlus Medical Encyclopedia: Urine specific gravity test

measures: A urine specific gravity test shows the total concentration of all particles in your urine. It helps show how well your body is balancing water and how concentrated your urine is.
context: How much fluid you drink strongly affects this result, and it is usually part of a routine urinalysis. Some medicines, recent anesthesia, or intravenous contrast dye from an imaging scan can also affect it.
aboveRange: Loss of body fluids, such as dehydration
Glucose in the urine or a high sodium level in the blood
Adrenal gland or hormone conditions, or shock
belowRange: Kidney conditions, including a serious kidney infection
A low sodium level in the blood
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
